messages:
sofia: Quick ask @eng-runtime — we need a minimal verified bundle for the launch post: 3 hero rows (p50/p95/tokens/s), raw CSVs, exact run command, image hash, and a 1-sentence methodology blurb. Deadline: Thu morning.

sanjay: OK. Which configs?

sofia: redwood-1.3b fp16 + int8, seq=64 and 256, batch 1 and 8, streaming off. Keep runs small but reproducible.

mike: I'll run 2k requests per config with 100 warmups. Using runtime-bench v0.9 and seed=123. Example:
```
./runtime-bench --model redwood-1.3b --variant fp16 --seq 64 --batch 1 --runs 2000 --warmup 100 --seed 123 --out ./out/fp16-64-b1.csv
```

elaine: Add GPU and driver to metadata: A100-40GB, driver 525.60, docker runtime nvidia. Also include model checksum.

sanjay: We'll pin model hash and deterministic tokenization. No caching. I'll upload artifacts to https://files.internal/redwood/marketing/launch/1782000000-bundle.zip.

runtime-ci-bot: job #552001 queued by @mike.

mike: Job finished: fp16 seq64 b1 — p50=30ms p95=85ms tokens/s=410. Uploaded CSV + small summary.csv.

sofia: Perfect. For the hero line use p95 for seq=64 fp16. Also add a short test-mix note: 70% short, 30% medium.

sanjay: Draft blurb: "Measured over 2,000 randomized requests per config after a 100-request warmup; deterministic tokenization, model pinned to hash d0c9f3. Reports show p50/p95 and tokens/sec; raw data attached for reproducibility."

sofia: Great — we'll iterate if any reruns change by >15%. Thanks team! :rocket:
